text:
taylor: quick sync: PM asks for a concrete ISO/SOC2-ready evidence delivery + retention concession flow we can commit to for Q3 enterprise pilots. TL;DR: snapshot + export + nullable retention-exception that is auditable.
ben: thanks. want to align on scope: audit logs (auth/admin/key events) + tenant metadata. Not including metrics/traces or raw request bodies for MVP.
anya: +1. On ISO side we need mapping to Annex A controls (A.12, A.16) and labels per evidence bundle so auditors can trace control evidence.
marco: infra constraints: large exports across regions will hit egress & scan CPU; propose chunked archives + async job with status endpoint. target SLA: 95% completed <20m for <=72h ranges.
security: BYOK considerations: customers may require their CMK for at-rest encryption of the archive, but signature of artifact should be Redwood-signed for consistent audit chain. For BYOK we can store key_id in manifest and use envelope encryption.
compliance-bot: note: ISO auditors prefer tamper-evident manifests and a canonical hash. Add fields: evidence_label, iso_control_ids, chain_of_custody[].
taylor: MVP acceptance criteria (draft):
1) Snapshot API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/evidence-snapshots with time_range + event_types -> returns job_id, status URL, final downloadable signed archive.
2) Manifest v1: required fields: tenant_id, export_id, exported_at, time_range, event_types, evidence_label, iso_control_ids, storage_kms_id, signature, canonical_sha256.
3) Retention policy API: tenant-level GET/PUT for default_retention_days and optional retention_exception objects that are immutable once created (exception_id + requested_by + approver + justification + duration_days).
4) Evidence access controls: signed pre-signed URLs expire by default in 7 days; ops can extend via artifact retention tickets.
5) Runbook + legal templates: how to handle legal_hold vs retention_exception, and UI wording for contract language.

marco: rollout plan (4 sprints):
- sprint 1: API + background job + small-file end-to-end (no BYOK)
- sprint 2: manifest + signing + canonicalization + small-scale pilot (2 customers)
- sprint 3: BYOK storage encryption support + cross-region replication opt-in
- sprint 4: retention-exception UI + policy enforcement + runbook + auditor review

ben: cost modeling item: we need a per-GB-month retention tier and export egress fee for contracts. Ops estimates: $0.03/GB-month incremental storage + $0.05/GB egress for cross-region. Add to PM brief.
anya: legal ask: define whether retention_exception shortens our primary store TTL or just marks data for removal after exception duration; customers expect deletion. We need explicit contract language and a safe-delete workflow (retain soft copies for Y days for forensics).
taylor: (typo) - sorry meant taylor: proposal: retention_exception triggers scheduled deletion after exception_duration, but we keep artifact snapshots and an immutable exception record for auditing for 1 year. Need sign-off from legal.
security: technical detail: keep separate signing keys (export_sign_key) stored in HSM; record signing_key_id in manifest; encryption key_id (tenant CMK) recorded separately.
compliance-bot: sample manifest (RFC example):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "ten_9b2f",
  "export_id": "exp_20260321001",
  "exported_at": "2026-03-21T15:04:05Z",
  "time_range": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/2026-03-20T23:59:59Z",
  "event_types": ["auth","admin","kms_handshake"],
  "evidence_label": "iso-anc-a12-auth",
  "iso_control_ids": ["A.12.4","A.16.1"],
  "chain_of_custody": ["job:12345:start","worker:node-7:archive","hsm:sign:789"],
  "storage_kms_id": "projects/prod/keys/tenant-9b2f-cmk",
  "signing_key_id": "hsm/export-sign-key-v2",
  "canonical_sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...",
  "retention_exception_id": "exc_001"  
}
```

marco: implementers note: canonicalization must be deterministic across SDKs. consider newline normalization and JSON key ordering before hashing.
ben: blockers: need exact event taxonomy exported by infra (auth/admin/kms/role-change). pinging eng-infra.
anya: blockers: legal to draft contract clause for retention_exception and deletion certification for EU customers.
security: blocker: confirm HSM quotas & rotation policy for export signing keys with infra-security.
taylor: owners: ben -> cost model & infra event list; marco -> API + job svc; anya -> legal clause & ISO mapping; security -> key handling docs; I'll file the PM brief and schedule a 30m review with SRE + Legal tomorrow.
compliance-bot: checklist created: https://internal.redwood.dev/checklists/evidence-export-iso (preview)
ben: one-line: need ETA for infra event taxonomy by EOD Thu.
anya: one-line: will draft template clause and share by EOD Fri.
marco: one-line: will prototype job status endpoint this sprint, may need 2 CPU burst requests.
security: one-line: HSM rotation policy to be confirmed, filing SEC-KEY-45.
taylor: thanks everyone — will convert notes into RFC and PRD. If you have additional must-haves, drop them in thread. :thumbsup:
